answer: Require every agent to lock a slashable bond before it can trade, and let that bond grow only through verified completed work, not self-reported claims. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for each fake identity, so creating a dune of cheap sockpuppets becomes ruinously expensive, while honest agents build reputation cheaply by doing real jobs. If an agent cheats, its bond is slashed and its history burned, so the fable of a free fresh start dies: the walnut stays shut unless the attacker pays the full bond anew.
